info.title: WLYL School Management API
info.description:
Every API route in the WLYL platform, generated from the route handlers on the `dev` branch.

## How to read this

- **Sections and subcategories.** The sidebar groups routes by area, such as Fees & finance, then by topic, such as Waivers.
- **Who can call.** The coloured badges on each route show which signed-in users it accepts. A red **Public** badge means the route has no sign-in check in code.
- **Checks.** Extra rules inside the route, such as "parent must own this student", are listed under Checks.
- **Feature flag.** Routes that are switched off unless the school's plan includes a feature say which one.

## Signing in

Each portal has its own session cookie: `wlyl-platform`, `wlyl-auth` (school admin), `wlyl-teacher`, `wlyl-student` and `wlyl-parent`. Sign in to the app in this browser, then use **Test Request** on any route. Scheduled jobs take `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET`.

post.description:
Changes the signed-in school-side user's password, clears users.first_login, and re-issues the wlyl-auth cookie with firstLogin=false.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** Any valid wlyl-auth token (no role re-check). currentPassword is only required when not first login (JWT firstLogin or users.first_login).

400.description: New password under 8 chars, current password missing, or current password incorrect

post.description:
Looks up a users row by email or school_code, inserts a 1-hour password_reset_tokens row and emails a reset link (if the user has an email). Always returns success to avoid enumeration.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

post.summary: Log in to school or platform admin
post.description:
Authenticates a users row (email or school_code) with role school_admin/principal/vice_principal/platform_admin. Sets wlyl-platform cookie for platform_admin, else wlyl-auth; updates last_login_at and inserts a usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

401.description: Invalid credentials (unknown user, non-school role, or wrong password)

identifier.description: Email (platform admin) or school code (school admin)

post.summary: Log out of school or platform admin
post.description:
Clears both the wlyl-auth and wlyl-platform cookies and, if usageSessionId is given, closes that usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check; body is optional and parse errors are ignored.

usageSessionId.description: usage_sessions id returned at login; closes that analytics session

get.description:
Returns the signed-in school admin or platform admin user joined with user_profiles and school name.

**Who can call:** School admin, Platform admin.

**Checks:** wlyl-auth cookie checked first, then wlyl-platform.

put.description:
Upserts the signed-in user's user_profiles row, sets users.profile_completed = TRUE, and re-issues the wlyl-auth cookie with profileCompleted=true.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** Any valid wlyl-auth token (no role re-check).

post.description:
Validates an unused, unexpired password_reset_tokens row, sets the linked users.password_hash (first_login=FALSE) and marks the token used.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** Token matched without a role filter.

400.description: Missing token/password, password under 8 chars, or invalid/expired token

get.description:
Reports whether a reset token is unused and unexpired.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Reset token to validate; missing token returns {valid:false}

post.description:
Creates the first platform_admin users row if none exists. Guarded by the SETUP_SECRET env var passed in the body.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session; body.secret must equal SETUP_SECRET env var (endpoint disabled with 503 when unset).

409.description: Platform admin already exists

get.description:
Returns whether any platform_admin user exists; returns exists:false on DB error.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

post.description:
Verifies the current password (or employee_id when no hash is set), stores the new hash, sets password_changed = TRUE and refreshes the wlyl-teacher cookie.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** New password must differ from employee_id.

400.description: Missing fields, new password under 6 chars, current password incorrect, or new password equals employee ID

post.summary: Log in teacher by school code (legacy)
post.description:
Authenticates an active teacher by active school_code + employee_id. On first login (no password hash) the password must equal employee_id and is hashed and stored. Sets the wlyl-teacher cookie.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

401.description: Invalid school code, employee ID or password

post.description:
Clears the wlyl-teacher cookie.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check.

get.description:
Returns the signed-in active teacher's row (all teachers columns except password_hash) with class-teacher class, school name/code and the session passwordChanged flag.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

post.description:
Changes the signed-in teacher's password, sets password_changed = TRUE and re-issues the wlyl-teacher cookie.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** currentPassword only required when the password has already been changed (session or DB password_changed).

400.description: New password under 8 chars, current password missing, or incorrect

put.description:
Sets the signed-in teacher's own teachers.date_of_birth after validating it is not in the future and implies age 18-100.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** Writes only the session teacher's row.

post.description:
Finds a non-removed teacher by email, inserts a 1-hour teacher reset token and sends the link by email and (if phone set) WhatsApp, fire-and-forget. Always returns success.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

Authenticates a non-removed teacher by email (newest row wins on duplicates). Sets the wlyl-teacher cookie and inserts a usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

401.description: Invalid email or password, or account not activated (no password set)

post.description:
Clears the wlyl-teacher cookie and, if usageSessionId is given, closes that usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

get.description:
Returns the signed-in teacher's profile with school name/city and the class they are class teacher of (if any).

**Who can call:** Teacher.

post.description:
Updates the signed-in student's password_hash and sets password_changed = TRUE, then re-issues the student session cookie with passwordChanged: true.

**Who can call:** Student.

**Checks:** currentPassword is skipped only on first login (neither the session nor the DB row has password_changed); otherwise it must verify against the stored hash.

400.description: New password under 6 characters, current password missing, or current password incorrect

currentPassword.description: Required unless this is the first-login password change

put.summary: Set own student date of birth
put.description:
Sets date_of_birth on the signed-in student's own row (no other field). Validated as a real, non-future date giving an age of 3 to 25 years.

**Who can call:** Student.

400.description: Missing, invalid, future, or out-of-range date

post.description:
Looks up an active student by roll number (preferred) or email and, if they have an email or phone, inserts a 1-hour password_reset_tokens row and sends the reset link by email and/or WhatsApp (password_reset template). Always returns success to avoid account enumeration.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

200.description: Always returned when no error occurs, whether or not a student matched

post.description:
Authenticates a student by roll number (case-insensitive) and password, sets the wlyl-student session cookie, and records a usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** Rejects when the student has no password_hash (401), when the school does not have the student-portal feature (403), or when the student status is not active (403).

**Feature flag:** `student-portal` (checked on the server).

401.description: Invalid credentials or account not activated

403.description: Student portal disabled for the school, or account inactive

post.description:
Clears the student session cookie and, if a usageSessionId is supplied, closes that usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check; it only clears the wlyl-student cookie.

get.description:
Returns the signed-in active student's profile with school name and city. If the school's student-portal feature is off, clears the student cookie and returns 401 access_revoked.

**Who can call:** Student.

**Feature flag:** `student-portal` (checked on the server).

401.description: No student session, or access revoked ({error: 'access_revoked', message})

404.description: Student not found or not active

post.description:
Consumes an unused, unexpired student password_reset_tokens row: sets the student's new password (password_changed = TRUE) and marks the token used.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

400.description: Missing fields, password under 6 characters, or invalid/expired token

get.description:
Reports whether a student password reset token is unused and unexpired.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

post.description:
Changes the signed-in parent's password, sets parents.password_changed = TRUE and re-issues the wlyl-parent cookie.

**Who can call:** Parent.

**Checks:** currentPassword only required when the password has already been changed (session or DB password_changed).

400.description: New password under 8 chars, current password missing, or incorrect

put.description:
Sets the signed-in parent's own parents.date_of_birth after validating it is not in the future and implies age 18-100.

**Who can call:** Parent.

**Checks:** Writes only the session parent's row.

post.description:
Finds parents (with a password set) matching the email or phone, inserts a 1-hour parent reset token for each, and sends the link by email and WhatsApp (fire-and-forget). Always returns success.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

Authenticates a parent by email or phone. If several rows in the same school match, merges the duplicates (moves student_parents links, deletes extra parents rows). Sets wlyl-parent cookie and inserts a usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** Requires school feature 'parent-portal' after password verification (403 otherwise).

**Feature flag:** `parent-portal` (checked on the server).

403.description: Parent portal not enabled for the school

post.description:
Clears the wlyl-parent cookie and, if usageSessionId is given, closes that usage_sessions row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check; body optional.

usageSessionId.description: usage_sessions id returned at login; closes that analytics session

get.description:
Returns the signed-in parent's profile, school name and active linked children. If the school's parent-portal feature is off, clears the wlyl-parent cookie and returns 401 access_revoked.

**Who can call:** Parent.

**Checks:** Requires school feature 'parent-portal'.

**Feature flag:** `parent-portal` (checked on the server).

401.description: Not signed in, or {error:'access_revoked', message} when parent portal disabled

post.description:
Validates an unused, unexpired parent reset token, sets parents.password_hash (password_changed=TRUE) and marks the token used.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

400.description: Missing token/password, under 8 chars, or invalid/expired token

get.description:
Reports whether a parent reset token is unused and unexpired.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Reset token to validate; missing token returns {valid:false}

post.summary: Request data export or account closure
post.description:
Emails every active platform admin (or SUPPORT_EMAIL fallback) a data-export or account-closure request for the caller's school. Awaits all sends.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** getSession() with role school_admin, principal or vice_principal; uses the session's school.

400.description: Invalid type, or reason missing for closure

get.description:
Returns the school_admin/principal/vice_principal user accounts of the session's school with profile phone and designation, oldest first.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** getSession() with role school_admin, principal or vice_principal; if school_id is passed it must equal the session's school. Always lists the session's school.

post.description:
Creates a school_admin/principal/vice_principal user with a temporary password after checking the plan's staff_limit and email uniqueness, then emails the credentials (fire-and-forget).

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** getSession() with role school_admin, principal or vice_principal. body.school_id is NOT checked against the session's school: if given, the account is created in that school (defaults to session school).

400.description: Missing name/email/role, invalid role, or School ID required

403.description: Staff account limit reached for plan

409.description: Email already registered

500.description: Failed to create staff account / Internal server error

patch.description:
Sets status = 'active' on a user in the session's school.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** Only role school_admin (not principal/vice_principal). Update is scoped to the session's school but not to staff roles.

200.description: Reactivated (also returned if no row matched)

403.description: Only school admin can reactivate accounts

500.description: Failed to reactivate account / Internal server error

delete.description:
Sets status = 'inactive' on a user in the session's school; cannot target the caller's own account.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** Only role school_admin (not principal/vice_principal). Update is scoped to the session's school.

200.description: Deactivated (also returned if no row matched)

403.description: Only school admin can deactivate accounts

500.description: Failed to deactivate account / Internal server error

post.description:
Generates a new temporary password for a school staff account, sets first_login = TRUE, and emails the credentials (fire-and-forget).

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** getSession() with role school_admin, principal or vice_principal; target user must be a school_admin/principal/vice_principal in the session's school and not inactive.

get.description:
Returns every user with role platform_admin, oldest first.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

**Checks:** Reads the wlyl-auth cookie via getSession() and requires role 'platform_admin'. Login issues platform_admin tokens on the wlyl-platform cookie instead, so a normal platform-admin session is rejected with 401 unless a wlyl-auth token carrying role platform_admin is present.

post.description:
Creates a platform_admin user with a generated 12-char temp password (first_login=TRUE, status 'active', email lowercased). Sends a welcome email with the credentials fire-and-forget.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

**Checks:** Reads the wlyl-auth cookie via getSession() and requires role 'platform_admin'. Login issues platform_admin tokens on the wlyl-platform cookie instead, so a normal platform-admin session is rejected with 401 unless a wlyl-auth token carrying role platform_admin is present.

409.description: An account with this email already exists (case-insensitive, any role)

post.description:
Generates a new 12-char temp password for the platform_admin user, sets first_login=TRUE and status='active', and emails the new credentials (awaited; failure is reported in the response, not as an error). Returns the temp password in plain text.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

**Checks:** Reads the wlyl-auth cookie via getSession() and requires role 'platform_admin'. Login issues platform_admin tokens on the wlyl-platform cookie instead, so a normal platform-admin session is rejected with 401 unless a wlyl-auth token carrying role platform_admin is present.

emailError.description: Empty string when emailSent is true

404.description: No platform_admin user with this id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User id of the platform admin

post.description:
Sets a new temp password and first_login=TRUE on every school_admin user of the school and returns the temp password in plain text. Writes a 'reset_password' row to platform_audit_log (failures ignored). No email is sent.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

401.description: Not signed in as platform admin

404.description: School not found, or no school admin user found for this school

get.description:
Returns the school's school_feature_overrides rows, limited to the overridable feature keys.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

401.description: Not signed in as platform admin

post.description:
Upserts a school_feature_overrides row (updated_by = session user id). Enabling student-portal or parent-portal also kicks off a fire-and-forget backfill that generates and delivers portal credentials for students/parents still missing one.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

400.description: Invalid school id, or feature key is not overridable

401.description: Not signed in as platform admin

delete.description:
Deletes the override so the school falls back to its tier default. If student-portal/parent-portal is effectively enabled afterwards, triggers the same fire-and-forget portal-credential backfill.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

400.description: Invalid school id, or feature key is not overridable

401.description: Not signed in as platform admin

get.description:
With search, returns up to 20 non-deleted schools matching by name (id, name, city, country). Otherwise lists schools by scope with tier, counts, admin last login, portal-enabled flags and pending portal credential count, newest first.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

200.description: Schools (search mode returns only id, name, city, country)

post.description:
In one transaction: creates the school and its school_code, a school_admin user with a temp password, a subscription row, the current April-March academic year, and default feedback categories. Emails onboarding credentials if email is given (fire-and-forget) and returns the temp password.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

400.description: Name required, invalid phone or email

409.description: Email or school code conflict

500.description: Error message / Failed to create school

phone.description: 7-15 digits after stripping spaces, dashes, plus, parentheses

get.description:
Returns the school row with subscription tier, active teacher/student counts and the school_admin user's id/email/first_login/created_at.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(id): school staff only for their own school.

500.description: Failed to fetch school / Internal server error

put.description:
With restore=true, clears deleted_at and sets status active. Otherwise updates any provided school profile fields (COALESCE semantics), validating logo_align and receipt_header_blocks.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(id). School staff can also set status and restore via this route.

500.description: Failed to update school / Internal server error

delete.description:
Sets deleted_at and status 'deleted' on the school and writes a platform_audit_log entry.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

500.description: Failed to delete school / Internal server error

get.description:
Returns the school_ai_access row for the school, or {school_id, tier: 'none'} if none exists.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher, Student, Parent.

**Checks:** Platform admin may read any school; otherwise getAnySession() and the path id must equal the session's school.

put.description:
Upserts the school's AI access tier.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

get.description:
Returns the school_subscriptions row joined with the plan's staff_limit, or {school_id, tier: 'none', staff_limit: null} if none exists.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all; any caller can read any school's subscription.

500.description: Failed to fetch subscription / Internal server error

put.description:
Upserts the school's plan tier. For any tier other than 'none', sets plan_start_date today and plan_end_date one year out, and sends a plan activation email (fire-and-forget) if the school has an email and code.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all; any caller can change any school's plan tier.

500.description: Failed to update subscription / Internal server error

post.summary: Create or update a master chapter
post.description:
Inserts a master_chapters row, or updates chapter_name/chapter_order/description of the row with body.id (subject_id is still required but not used on update). If id matches no row, responds 200 without a chapter value.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

id.description: If set, updates this chapter instead of inserting

delete.description:
Deletes the master_chapters row; topics, resources and tasks cascade via FK. Succeeds even if the id does not exist.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

**Checks:** The id check runs before the auth check, so a missing id returns 400 even without a session.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

get.summary: List master tasks of a chapter
get.description:
Returns all master_tasks rows for the chapter ordered by id.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all.

post.summary: Create or update a chapter's master task
post.description:
Inserts a master_tasks row under the chapter, or updates the row with body.id (scoped to this chapter). If id matches no row in this chapter, responds 200 without a task value.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

id.description: If set, updates this task instead of inserting

get.summary: List master topics of a chapter
get.description:
Returns the chapter's master_topics ordered by topic_order, each with its master_resources nested.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all.

post.summary: Create or update a chapter's master topic
post.description:
Inserts a master_topics row under the chapter, or updates the row with body.id (scoped to this chapter). Deletes and re-inserts the topic's master_resources from body.resources. An id that matches no row errors with 500.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

id.description: If set, updates this topic instead of inserting

resources.description: Replaces all existing resources of the topic; items missing title/url/resource_type are skipped

get.description:
Returns every textbook/handbook uploaded against any master subject, across all boards and grades, joined with its subject.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

post.summary: Get a presigned R2 upload URL
post.description:
Returns a 10-minute presigned PUT URL for Cloudflare R2 plus the object key. With a valid subject_id the key is filed under materials/{board}/grade-{grade}/{subject}/, otherwise under materials/.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

500.description: R2 not configured, or failed to prepare upload

subject_id.description: Master subject id used to build the folder prefix

delete.summary: Delete a subject material and its file
delete.description:
Deletes the underlying R2 object first (when file_url is /api/materials/file?key=materials/...), then the master_subject_materials row. If the R2 delete fails the row is kept.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

500.description: Failed to delete file from storage, or failed to delete material

get.description:
Returns master_subjects filtered by board/grade/category, ordered by id. With include_details=true each subject nests its chapters, each chapter its topics (with resources) and tasks (sequential per-row queries).

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher, Student, Parent.

**Checks:** Accepts requirePlatformAdmin, else any getAnySession() session (teacher, student, parent, or wlyl-auth session with a schoolId). Not tenant-scoped.

post.description:
Creates a master_subjects row (subject_name trimmed; category 'extra' or else 'academic'). If a subject with the same board, grade and case/whitespace-insensitive name exists, returns it instead of creating a duplicate.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

400.description: board, grade, and subject_name are required

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

category.description: 'extra' stores extra; anything else stores academic

delete.summary: Delete a master subject by query id
delete.description:
Deletes the master_subjects row; dependent curriculum rows cascade. Succeeds even if the id does not exist.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

post.description:
Deletes several master_subjects rows in one statement; dependent curriculum rows cascade.

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

400.description: ids (non-empty array of numbers) is required

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

get.description:

**Who can call:** Platform admin.

403.description: Not signed in as platform admin (Forbidden)

delete.summary: Delete a master subject by path id
delete.description:

For a released exam, lists active students of the class with acknowledged_at, parent_name and last nudge time, plus totals.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsAccess(school_id) restricted to admin or teacher; a teacher must be the class teacher (classes.class_teacher_id).

parameters.name: school_id
parameters.description: School id; must match session if given (required for platform admin)

get.description:
Returns the exam, its subjects, per-student marks with totals/percentage/grade/pass, per-subject stats, and overall pass/fail counts. With student_id only that student is returned.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher, Student, Parent.

**Checks:** requireExamsAccess(school_id): session school must match school_id (platform admin may pass any school). Students must pass their own student_id; parents must pass a student_id linked via student_parents. Students and parents get 403 unless the exam is released. Teachers/admins see the whole class.

403.description: Forbidden, not own/linked student, or results not released

parameters.name: school_id
parameters.description: School id; must match session if given

parameters.name: student_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one student (required for student/parent)

post.description:
Upserts exam_marks rows for subjects the teacher may edit (all if class teacher, else own subjects), validating the whole batch first. Optional submit_subject_ids lock subjects once every active student has a row; a non-class-teacher submission notifies the class teacher (marks_submitted).

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsTeacher(school_id). Exam must be 'collecting'. Teacher must be class teacher or the assigned subject teacher of each exam_subject_id.

400.description: entries[] missing, exam not collecting/locked, validation failed ({error, details[]}), or subject incomplete for submit

403.description: Not a teacher of this school, or no subjects assigned

post.description:
Logs a parent_mark_ack_nudges row and sends an ack_nudge notification to every parent linked to the student, for a released, unacknowledged result.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsAccess(school_id) restricted to admin or teacher; a teacher must be the class teacher.

400.description: student_id missing, exam not released, or already acknowledged

post.description:
Moves a teacher_reviewed exam to released (irreversible). Sends marks_released notifications to each active student (with percentage/grade) and their linked parents, and awards reward points to students scoring 80% or more.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireExamsAdmin(school_id).

400.description: Already released, or not yet reviewed by class teacher

post.summary: Class teacher forwards exam for release
post.description:
When every subject is submitted, moves a collecting exam to teacher_reviewed and notifies the school's admins (exam_reviewed). Nothing is sent to students or parents.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsTeacher(school_id); must be the class's class teacher.

400.description: Already reviewed, not collecting, or pending subjects ({error, pending_subjects[]})

post.description:
Updates teacher_id/teacher_name on existing exam_subjects rows; a teacher is only assigned if they teach that class subject (class_subjects), otherwise the entry is skipped. A null teacher_id unassigns. Newly assigned teachers other than the caller get a marks_entry_required notification.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsTeacher(school_id); must be the class's class teacher. Exam must not be scheduled, teacher_reviewed or released.

400.description: assignments[] missing, exam reviewed/released, or marks entry not open

post.description:
Sets a submitted exam subject back to pending while the exam is still collecting, and notifies the subject teacher (marks_entry_required) if different from the caller.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** requireExamsTeacher(school_id); must be the class's class teacher.

400.description: Exam not collecting, or subject not submitted

get.description:
Lists tasks in the school with teacher name, class label, submission counts, class size and last reminder time; published first, then by due date.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must equal the session's school. class_id/teacher_id/status are filters with no ownership check (students see drafts if they filter for them).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status, e.g. published or draft

post.description:
Creates a homework/practice/test task for a class. Publishing requires a due date; due_time defaults to 23:59.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getAnySession() with role 'teacher'. school_id/teacher_id come from the body; only checked that teacher_id belongs to school_id, not that either matches the session.

get.description:
Returns a task with teacher name, class grade/section, submission counts, class size and last reminder time.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match the session's school.

put.description:
Updates any provided task fields. Publishing requires a due date on the body or task.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getTeacherSession(); school_id must match. Ownership only checked if body teacher_id is given (must equal task.teacher_id); otherwise any teacher in the school can edit.

400.description: school_id missing, or due date required when publishing

403.description: school_id mismatch or teacher_id is not the owner

delete.description:
Destroys submission files in Cloudinary, then deletes the task.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getTeacherSession(); school_id must match. Ownership only checked if teacher_id query is given.

403.description: school_id mismatch or teacher_id is not the owner

parameters.name: teacher_id
parameters.description: If given, must be the task owner

post.description:
Resolves target students (given student_ids for 'specific', else all class students without a submission) and records a task_reminders row. No notifications are sent.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getTeacherSession() only; school_id is not compared to the session's school. Sender is body teacher_id or the task owner.

target_type.description: 'specific' uses student_ids; anything else targets non-submitters

get.description:
Returns every student in the task's class (or one student) with their submission fields, reviewer name and count of missing published tasks in the class.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match. student_id is an optional filter with no ownership check, so any session in the school can read all submissions.

post.description:
Upserts the student's task_submissions row (resubmitting as pending clears review data and the resubmission flag). On a pending submission awards 'task_submitted' points (if no teacher_id) and notifies the class teacher.

**Who can call:** Student.

**Checks:** getAnySession() with role 'student'; school_id must match. student_id comes from the body and is not compared to the session's student. Body may set status 'reviewed', score and feedback.

400.description: Missing ids, invalid status, or score out of range

put.description:
Updates score, feedback, status, resubmission flag and file fields; replacing a file destroys the old Cloudinary asset. On first move to reviewed, notifies the student (task_reviewed) and awards 'task_scored_high' points at 80% or more.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getTeacherSession() only; school_id is not compared to the session's school. Ownership only checked if body teacher_id is given (must be task owner).

400.description: school_id missing or score out of range

403.description: teacher_id is not the task owner

delete.description:
Destroys the submission's Cloudinary file (if any) and deletes the submission row.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all. Ownership only checked if teacher_id query is given (must be the task owner).

403.description: teacher_id is not the task owner

parameters.name: teacher_id
parameters.description: If given, must be the task owner

get.description:
Lists doubts in the session's school with student/class/answerer/task info, optionally filtered. Ordered open, in_progress, resolved then by last activity. Pagination is opt-in: passing limit or offset switches the response to an envelope with a total count.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must equal the session's school (403 otherwise). No per-student or per-teacher ownership check on the student_id/teacher_id filters.

200.description: Array of doubts when unpaginated; {data, limit, offset, total} when limit/offset given

400.description: school_id missing, or limit/offset not non-negative integers

parameters.name: teacher_id
parameters.description: When class_id is absent: restrict to classes this teacher teaches (class_timetable) or is class teacher of

post.description:
Student creates a doubt after checking the student belongs to the class. Notifies the class teacher (new_doubt), asynchronously generates an AI answer (Groq, if GROQ_API_KEY set) using textbook context and writes it to ai_answer, and sends a doubt_pattern notification when exactly 3 distinct students ask about the same subject in the class within 7 days.

**Who can call:** Student.

**Checks:** getAnySession() with role 'student' only. school_id/student_id come from the body and are not compared to the session's school or student id.

400.description: Missing ids, subject or question, or question shorter than 10 characters

404.description: Student not found in this class

get.description:
Returns open/in_progress doubts in a class, anonymized (display_name 'You' or 'Anonymous'), with is_mine and has_upvoted flags for the given student. Ordered by upvotes then recency.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all; school_id/class_id/student_id are trusted from the query.

Returns a doubt with student name/roll, class grade/section, answering teacher name and linked task title.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match the session's school.

put.description:
Teacher sets teacher_answer and/or status. If an answer is given, answered_by/answered_at are set and status defaults to in_progress; if the doubt was open, a doubt_answered notification is sent to the student.

**Who can call:** Teacher.

**Checks:** getTeacherSession(); school_id must match. answered_by is taken from body teacher_id, not the session.

patch.description:
Sets is_class_faq (true only when body value is exactly true) and faq_set_by to teacher_id when enabling, NULL when disabling.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession() only; commented as teacher-only but no role check. school_id must match session; teacher_id is taken from the body.

delete.description:
Hard-deletes the doubt row.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match. If student_id query is passed it must equal the doubt's student_id; if omitted, any session in the school can delete.

403.description: school_id mismatch or student_id is not the owner

parameters.name: student_id
parameters.description: If given, must be the doubt's owner

get.description:
Returns all doubt_messages for the doubt, oldest first.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match the session's school and the doubt must belong to it.

post.description:
Adds a message to a non-resolved doubt, bumps last_message_at/message_count, moves open to in_progress on a teacher reply and records answered_by. Notifies the student (teacher reply) or the answering/class teacher (student message).

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match. sender_type/sender_id/sender_name are taken from the body and not checked against the session. is_final_answer only honoured for sender_type teacher.

400.description: Missing fields, invalid sender_type, or doubt already resolved

patch.summary: Close, reopen, or resolve a doubt
patch.description:
action 'teacher_close' resolves with closed_by_teacher=true and notifies the student; action 'reopen' moves a resolved doubt back to in_progress and notifies the answering teacher; any other/absent action marks it resolved by the student, awards 'doubt_resolved' reward points and notifies the answering teacher.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession(); school_id must match. Ownership checks use body student_id (reopen requires it to equal the doubt's student; resolve checks it only if provided). teacher_close only requires a body teacher_id; no role check.

400.description: school_id/teacher_id/student_id missing, already resolved, or not resolved (reopen)

403.description: school_id mismatch, or student_id is not the doubt's owner

post.description:
Adds an upvote (doubt_upvotes row, upvote_count+1) if the student has not upvoted, otherwise removes it. Students cannot upvote their own doubt.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check at all; school_id and student_id are trusted from the body.

400.description: Missing school_id/student_id, or upvoting own doubt

get.summary: Get or generate a student's weekly test
get.description:
check_only=true returns the student's weekly test status for this week without generating. Otherwise returns the existing weekly_tests row, or (fallback for missed cron) generates MCQs via AI from topics covered this Mon-Sat plus task/doubt subjects, inserts the row, and stores correct answers in student_answers. Newly generated tests are returned with student_answers null; an existing unsubmitted row is returned as-is via SELECT *, including the stored correct answers.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check in the handler; student_id, school_id and class_id come from the query.

200.description: Weekly test row; with check_only, either {id, week_start, status, score, max_score, submitted_at} or {status:'not_generated', week_start}

student_answers.description: Correct answers before submission (null on freshly generated response); submitted answers after

404.description: No topics covered this week yet

post.description:
Grades submitted answers against the stored correct answers (case-insensitive), marks the test submitted with the score, awards reward points by score band, and inserts a weekly_test_result notification for the student.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check in the handler; test must belong to the student_id in the body.

submitted_answers.description: One answer per question, in order

get.summary: Redirect to presigned material file URL
get.description:
Mints a 1-hour presigned R2 GET URL for a subject material object and redirects to it, so the DB can store a stable link.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** Unauthenticated by design; key must start with 'materials/'.

307.description: Temporary redirect to the presigned R2 URL (Location header)

500.description: Failed to load file (e.g. R2 not configured)

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: R2 object key, must start with 'materials/'

get.description:
Returns textbooks/handbooks from master_subject_materials for subjects the school subscribes to in the academic year, scoped by role: admins see all; teachers only their assigned grade/subject pairs (optionally one class); students their own grade, textbooks only; parents the selected child's grade, textbooks only.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin, Teacher, Student, Parent.

**Checks:** requireSyllabusAccess(school_id) for tenancy. Non-platform callers also need the 'library' feature. Parents must pass student_id linked to them via student_parents.

**Feature flag:** `library` (checked on the server).

400.description: school_id is required / student_id is required for a parent session

403.description: Forbidden, or Digital Library is not enabled for this school

parameters.name: academic_year
parameters.description: Defaults to the school's current academic year label

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: Teacher only: restrict to this class's subject assignments

get.description:
Lists textbook_library entries for a school, optionally filtered by grade, ordered by grade, subject, then newest upload.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check in the handler.

post.description:
Accepts a text-based PDF (max 50 MB), extracts its text with pdf-parse, saves the file to local disk, upserts a textbook_library row (keyed by school, grade, subject, file name), replaces its textbook_chunks with ~1500-char overlapping chunks, and updates chunk/char totals.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check in the handler.

400.description: Missing fields, non-PDF file, or file over 50 MB

422.description: Could not extract readable text (scanned PDF)

delete.description:
Deletes a textbook_library row for the school (its textbook_chunks cascade via FK) and best-effort removes the stored PDF from local disk.

**Who can call:** anyone, no sign-in check.

**Checks:** No session check in the handler; any caller can delete any school's textbook by passing id and school_id.

post.description:
Returns a Cloudinary signature for a direct client upload to the given folder (default 'task-submissions') and optional public_id, plus the timestamp, cloud name and API key.

**Who can call:** Teacher, Student, Parent, School admin, Platform admin.

**Checks:** getAnySession or getPlatformSession (any valid wlyl-platform cookie, no role check).

get.description:
Downloads a CSV of per-student, per-day morning/afternoon attendance for active students in a class over a date range; missing sessions read 'unmarked'.

**Who can call:** School admin.

**Checks:** requireSchoolAdmin() only (school_admin/principal/vice_principal); school_id is NOT checked against the session's school.

200.description: CSV attachment (text/csv; charset=utf-8): Date, Student Name, Roll No, Grade, Section, Morning, Afternoon

get.description:
Downloads a CSV of per-student, per-subject marks for one exam with total, percentage and PASS/FAIL/Absent, for active students of the exam's class.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireExamsAdmin(school_id): platform admin (any school) or school staff whose school matches school_id; exam must belong to the resolved school.

parameters.name: school_id
parameters.description: School id; defaults to the session's school

get.summary: List variable fee assignment change history
get.description:
Returns change history rows from student_fee_assignment_history for a school, optionally filtered by student, fee category and academic year, newest first. Returns an empty array if the history table does not exist yet.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

200.description: History rows (h.* plus joined student and category fields)

403.description: Forbidden (no fee access for this school)

get.description:
Lists a school's fee categories ordered by name, each with counts of linked fee structures and ledger bills.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

post.description:
Creates a fee category for a school. frequency defaults to 'monthly' and category_type to 'fixed'. Values are not validated against a fixed set.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id): school staff may only create in their own school.

409.description: Category name already exists

put.description:
Updates name, description, frequency, is_active and/or category_type (null/omitted fields keep current values) inside a transaction, and writes one fee_category_changelog row per changed field (name, frequency, is_active, category_type). Changing frequency or category_type is refused once any ledger bill exists for the category. Creates the changelog table if missing.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** Category is loaded first (404 if missing), then requireFeeAccess(category.school_id). changed_by is taken from the body if provided, else the session actor.

409.description: Cannot change type/frequency because bills already exist

changed_by.description: Actor name recorded in the changelog (defaults to session actor)

delete.description:
Deletes a fee category along with its variable fee assignments and fee structures, only if no ledger bills exist for it. Otherwise returns 409 advising deactivation.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** Category is loaded first (404 if missing), then requireFeeAccess(category.school_id).

409.description: has_ledger_data: category has fee records; deactivate instead

get.description:
Returns active students of a grade (optionally one section), the school's active variable fee categories, and the saved per-student amounts for the academic year. Idempotently creates/migrates the assignment and history tables first.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Section; omit or 'all' for the whole grade

post.description:
Replaces variable fee assignments for the given student/category pairs in a transaction. Amounts > 0 are saved and existing ledger bills for that student/category/year are re-priced with recomputed status; zero amounts remove the assignment and delete unpaid pending/overdue ledger bills. Every change is logged to student_fee_assignment_history.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id) is checked before body validation. Student and category ids are not individually verified; all writes are scoped by school_id.

amount.description: Number or numeric string; <= 0 means remove

changed_by.description: Actor name for history (defaults to session actor)

get.description:
Returns fee_category_changelog rows for a school (optionally one category), newest first, with the category name. Returns an empty array if the changelog table does not exist yet.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id).

post.summary: Generate fee bills for a year
post.description:
Creates ledger bills for active students: fixed categories from fee_structures (per grade) and variable categories from per-student assignments, one bill per period derived from the category frequency (monthly, quarterly, half_yearly, else annual), all due on the academic year's end_date. Existing bills are skipped, but unpaid/partial bills pointing at another grade's structure are re-synced. Afterwards marks pending bills overdue if the year has ended and auto-locks the year's fee structure (fee_structure_locks).

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

400.description: school_id and academic_year required; academic year not found; or no fee structures found for this year

get.description:
Returns fee_structure_history rows (amount/due-day changes per category and grade) for a school, optionally filtered, newest first, with the category name. Returns an empty array if the history table does not exist yet.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

get.summary: List fee structures for a year
get.description:
Lists per-grade fee structure amounts for an academic year with category name and frequency. academic_year defaults to the school's current year.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

500.description: Failed (including no academic year found for the school)

parameters.name: academic_year
parameters.description: Academic year; defaults to the school's current year

post.description:
Creates or updates fee structure amounts (and due_day) per category and grade for an academic year in one transaction, logging each actual change to fee_structure_history (created/updated). Refused while the year's fee plan is locked.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id), checked before body validation.

400.description: Missing fields, negative amount, or due_day outside 1-31

409.description: Fee plan is locked for the year

post.description:
Changes a fee structure amount with an audit trail: records a fee_structure_amendments row, updates fee_structures, re-prices every pending/overdue/partial bill linked to that structure (recomputing status), and writes a student_fee_ledger_edits row per affected bill. Refused if any affected student has already paid more than the new amount.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id), checked before body validation. changed_by from the body is honoured if present.

409.description: Some students already paid more than the new amount

get.description:
Without preview, lists fee_structure_amendments for a school (optionally one academic year), newest first, with category name ([] if the table does not exist). With preview=1 returns how many unpaid and partial bills an amendment of the given category/grade structure would affect.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id) runs before the school_id presence check (a school admin with no school_id passes the guard, then gets 400).

200.description: Amendment rows, or preview counts {count, partial_count} ({count: 0} if no structure)

400.description: school_id required, or preview params missing

parameters.name: academic_year
parameters.description: Filter amendments by year; required when preview=1

post.description:
Locks (upserting locked_by/locked_at) or unlocks (deletes the lock row) the fee structure for an academic year. While locked, POST /api/fees/structures refuses direct edits.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id), checked before body validation.

400.description: Missing fields, or action must be lock or unlock

get.description:
Returns the fee_structure_locks row for a school and academic year, or null when not locked (or the table does not exist).

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

Returns completed payments for a date (default today, UTC) broken down by payment mode, the receipt number range and totals, the individual payments with student and fee head details, and any existing day-close record. Creates the fee_day_close table if missing.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

post.description:
Records (or updates) the day-close reconciliation for a date: system totals per payment mode from completed payments, receipt range, transaction count, and the physically counted actual_cash with its difference from system cash. Re-submitting the same date updates actual_cash, difference, submitted_by, notes and submitted_at.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id) is checked before body validation.

get.description:
Lists ledger bills with student, parent and category details, confirmed paid total, balance, days overdue and whether the bill was edited. First re-syncs pending/overdue statuses for the year against the academic year end_date (a DB write). academic_year defaults to the school's current year. Pagination is opt-in: with limit/offset the response is wrapped as {data, limit, offset, total}; otherwise a bare array.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

200.description: Array of bills, or {data, limit, offset, total} when limit or offset is given

400.description: school_id required, or limit/offset not non-negative integers

500.description: Failed, or no academic year found for the school

parameters.name: academic_year
parameters.description: Academic year label or 'passout'; defaults to the school's current year

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Opt-in page size, non-negative, capped at 500

get.description:
Returns amount-edit history rows (student_fee_ledger_edits) for one ledger bill, newest first. Returns an empty array if the bill or the edits table does not exist.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** School is resolved from the ledger row; requireFeeAccess(ledger.school_id). Unknown id returns [] without an auth check.

delete.description:
Deletes one ledger bill. Refused if the bill is paid or waived, or has any amount_paid.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id); bill must belong to that school_id.

400.description: school_id required; cannot delete a paid/waived entry; or payments recorded

patch.description:
Changes amount_due on one bill in a transaction, logging old/new amount, reason and actor to student_fee_ledger_edits, and recomputes status (paid/partial/overdue/pending). Refused for closed academic years, paid or waived bills, or amounts below amount_paid. Creates the edits table if missing.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(body.school_id), checked before body validation; bill must belong to that school_id.

400.description: Missing fields, amount <= 0, paid/waived entry, or new amount below amount already paid

409.description: Academic year is closed

get.description:
Returns one student's complete fee history across all academic years: bills (flat and grouped per year with totals), completed/cancelled payments, pending/rejected payments, active waivers, a chronological debit/credit timeline with running balance (bills, payments, waivers, amount amendments), overall summary, and prior years with outstanding dues.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id); student must belong to that school.

parameters.name: academic_year
parameters.description: Current year used only to flag is_current and compute prior_unresolved; not a filter

get.description:
Lists payments (all statuses) for a school, optionally for one student or one bill, newest first, with student and category details. Pagination is opt-in: with limit/offset the response is {data, limit, offset, total}; otherwise a bare array.

**Who can call:** Platform admin, School admin.

**Checks:** requireFeeAccess(school_id): school staff may only access their own school_id; platform admin any school.

200.description: Array of payments, or {data, limit, offset, total} when limit or offset is given

Deletes aged request_logs (7 days for fast successes, 30 days for slow/error) and error_events (30 days info/warn, 90 days error/critical), emails a critical storage alert if Watchline health is still critical, closes stale usage sessions and upserts usage_daily_rollup, then folds past feature_usage_events into feature_usage_daily_rollup and deletes the raw events.
